title: Malmö demonstration for Gaza within coordinated July 12–13 weekend actions
scope: One confirmed Malmö gathering within a coordinated multi-city weekend; no attendance from other cities is pooled.
organizer: Stoppa Israel network identified as an umbrella group behind national demonstrations; local organizer unknown.

state_target.target: Swedish government trade policy toward Israel
state_target.evidence: SVT reports Stoppa Israel demanded the government stop all Swedish trade with Israel.

demands_original: Stoppa Israel demanded the Swedish government stop all Swedish trade with Israel.
participants_original: Up to around 1,500 participants in Malmö, according to police as reported by SVT.
threshold_50_evidence: SVT reports up to around 1,500 at the Malmö site, clearly above 50. The separate hunger-strike group count and network size are not attendee counts.

start_date.summary: SVT says the Malmö demonstration was Sunday 13 July 2025; organizer lists the event that day.

location.summary: SVT identifies Malmö; organizer notice lists Stortorget as meeting point.

scope.summary: SVT says demonstrations occurred in several cities; this row uses only Malmö.

organizer.summary: SVT identifies Stoppa Israel network, but not the local Malmö organizer; network size is not attendance.

state_target.summary: SVT says the network demanded Sweden's government stop all Swedish trade with Israel.

demands.summary: Demand concerns Swedish trade/foreign policy; coded political_behavior_process.

participants_original.summary: SVT reports up to around 1,500 in Malmö according to police.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Site-specific report of up to around 1,500, well above threshold.

notes: Only Malmö's site-specific estimate is used; other cities listed in an organizer notice are not counted.
open_questions: Who organized the Malmö site locally? Was there a response or continuation? Were other listed sites held and with what own counts?

title: Stockholm demonstration against Israeli attacks on Gaza, 19 July
location: Stockholm; march from Odenplan toward the Swedish Parliament
scope: One gathering, separate from 13 and 26 July; common organizers/continuity not established.
organizer: Unknown; report quotes an activist but does not identify an organizing body.

state_target.target: Article reports Gaza-focused demands; one interviewee calls for Swedish parties to boycott Israel and expel its ambassador, but this is not shown as a collective demand.

demands_original: Report describes demand to end violence in Gaza; one quoted participant proposed that Swedish parties boycott Israel and expel its ambassador.
participants_original: Hundreds of people gathered, according to Anadolu Agency.
threshold_50_evidence: Anadolu describes hundreds at the Stockholm gathering, supporting at least 50 at this site.

start_date.summary: Anadolu report dated 19 July says the gathering was Saturday 19 July.

location.summary: The march is described from Odenplan toward the Swedish Parliament.

scope.summary: One Stockholm event; no linkage to other July events is established.

state_target.summary: General demand concerns Gaza; a participant's Swedish-policy statement leaves collective state targeting unresolved.

demands.summary: No category assigned pending evidence the individual policy statement was collective.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Qualitative report of hundreds at one site.

notes: Whether the Swedish-policy statement represents the group is unresolved.
open_questions: Was the boycott/expulsion position a collective demand? Was there an event-specific response or continuation?

title: Stockholm demonstration for Gaza, 26 July
location: Stockholm; exact site and route not given
scope: One gathering, distinct from 13 and 19 July; organizer/continuity unknown.

state_target.target: Report describes solidarity with people in Gaza; no Swedish-government demand is stated.

demands_original: Demonstrators showed support for people in Gaza facing hunger; Swedish minister's remarks about foreign aid are not a protest demand.
participants_original: Hundreds of people gathered in Stockholm.
threshold_50_evidence: Sveriges Radio describes hundreds at one Stockholm site.

start_date.summary: Sveriges Radio says the gathering was Saturday 26 July 2025.

scope.summary: One gathering; no link to other July events established.

state_target.summary: Report describes support for Gaza; no own-state demand stated.

demands.summary: No own-state category assigned from the article.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Qualitative report of hundreds at one site.

notes: Do not infer a demand from the minister's separate remarks about aid drops.
open_questions: Did demonstrators make a Swedish-state demand not reported? Who organized the event; any response or continuity?
